metadata.description: Savings USDS (sUSDS) is the yield-bearing savings token of the Sky protocol on Ethereum, issued as an ERC-4626 vault share over USDS. Depositing USDS mints sUSDS at the prevailing rate; the holder's balance then stays fixed while each share becomes redeemable for a growing amount of USDS, so the token is non-rebasing and requires no reward claims. Yield comes from the Sky Savings Rate, a parameter set by Sky governance and funded from protocol revenue. USDS can be redeemed at any time with no lockup or cooldown. The token sits behind an ERC-1967 upgradeable proxy under Sky governance control.
